summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings impacting businesses, alongside notable retail earnings amidst a fluctuating market environment.

bullets.text: Supreme Court grants bail to Sahara Group executive, directing trial court to frame charges within 4 months.
Delhi High Court grants interim relief to Emami Agrotech against FSSAI actions, citing lack of legal compliance.
Shoppers Stop reports Q2 FY27 profit with consolidated revenue rising 7% to Rs 1,618 crore.
Mukesh Ambani's Jio sets IPO price band, signaling a major move in the telecom sector.
India's Reliance and Airtel stocks rally as Jio Platforms IPO reshapes market valuations.
